hero.chip: National Committee for the Democratization of Fact-Checking
hero.title: Access to reliable information is a right. Fact-checking, the tool to claim it.
hero.description: Join the first Committee created to democratize fact-checking practices in Brazil. A network that already brings together representatives from the five regions of the country and Portugal. The Committee is made up of educators, researchers, students, institutions, and professionals committed to democracy, who actively work to combat misinformation.
hero.quote: ”Misinformation is an existential threat to democracy. Fighting it requires unity, method, and collective commitment.”

mission.title: Building a society where reliable information is accessible to all
mission.description: AletheiaFact.org is a non-profit organization focused on combating misinformation and democratizing access to fact-checking. We believe that a well-informed society strengthens the pillars of democracy.

combat.title: Fighting disinformation
combat.description: We reject the reactive logic of acting only during fleeting crises. Our methodology and technology analyze every stage of the information cycle.

territorial.title: Territorial reach
territorial.description: We connect researchers and institutions across all Brazilian macro-regions. This decentralized organization ensures an agile response that is sensitive to the cultural, social, and media diversity of each territory.

multiplicators.title: Multiplier educators
multiplicators.description: We bring educommunication-based methodologies into higher education. By offering accessible teaching materials and structured tools for professors, we turn undergraduate programs into a continuous breeding ground for critical professional development.

infrastructure.title: Open and auditable infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The entire Committee workflow is anchored in the open-source ecosystem. We provide multi-stage review systems and a transparent public repository that serves as a database for research and public policy.

mission.closingQuote: Together, we can build a more informed and resilient society against misinformation. This is our commitment to education, innovation, and the strengthening of democracy.

benefits.title: Benefits for you and your institution
benefits.description: By being part of the National Committee for the Democratization of Fact-Checking, you and your university will have access to exclusive resources and unique collaboration opportunities.

certification.title: Recognized Certification
certification.description: Receive certificates that can be used as complementary hours at your institution.

materials.title: Exclusive Materials
materials.description: Access templates, practical guides, and educational resources for direct application in the classroom.

research.title: Research Support
research.description: Facilitate studies and projects in partnership with AletheiaFact.org, integrating theory and practice.

support.title: Specialized Support
support.description: Count on consulting for the implementation of fact-checking centers at your institution.

visibility.title: National Visibility
visibility.description: Gain public recognition as a partner institution in the fight against misinformation.

reports.title: Impact Reports
reports.description: Follow the documentation of results for accountability and fundraising.

pact.title: Our Collaboration Pact
pact.description: The Committee operates in open source. Methods, data, and results are shared among members, so each institution's progress accelerates the work of all. This is how fact-checking is democratized, adding, never competing.
